name: Inside an FPV flight controller

levels.title: SpeedyBee F405 V5 flight controller
levels.text: A 39 mm square board weighing 8.1 g. The ICM42688P gyro reports rotation thousands of times a second; the STM32F405 turns each reading into four new motor commands for the ESC.
levels.caption: Sense, decide, command: thousands of times a second.

levels.title: STM32F405 microcontroller
levels.text: A 10 × 10 mm LQFP64 package with 64 leads at 0.5 mm pitch. Inside, a 90 nm die carries a 168 MHz Cortex-M4F core, 1 MB of flash and 192 KB of RAM.
levels.caption: The whole flight runs through 64 pins.

subtitle: From a 5-inch quad’s flight controller down to the microcontroller that flies it: it reads its gyro thousands of times a second and answers with four motor commands.

finale.title: 64 pins fly the quad.
finale.text: Every stick input, gyro sample and motor command passes through this 10 mm chip.
